name: Queen Creek
seo_title: Queen Creek Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 5 Events, 3 Free
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Queen Creek, AZ: QC Hometown Christmas, Christmas at Schnepf Farms with its train ride, Cowboy Christmas and Santa playdates.
lede: Queen Creek celebrates Christmas with a Town Center tree lighting and parade, a farm that turns into a million-light holiday park, and a cowboy market at Horseshoe Park.
celebrates: The Town of Queen Creek runs QC Hometown Christmas at Queen Creek Town Center on South Ellsworth Road, with a Friday evening tree lighting and a Saturday morning parade. The town's page lists pictures with Santa, letters to Santa, Santa's Workshop for decorating garland and ornaments, community stage performances, a scavenger hunt and food trucks. Christmas at Schnepf Farms adds a train ride, ice skating, a Christmas carousel, reindeer hayrides, cookie decorating with Mrs. Claus and snow globe mini golf. Horseshoe Park & Equestrian Centre holds Cowboy Christmas and Trade Days with a Kids Zone.
lastyear: In 2025, QC Hometown Christmas began with a Friday tree lighting on December 5 from 6 to 8 pm, followed by the parade on Saturday, December 6, at 10 am. The town's Know Before You Go notice described the parade as Rockin' Around QC, running on Ellsworth Road from Maya to Aldecoa Drive. Free activities included community stage entertainment, pictures with Santa, a Santa's Workshop for garland and ornaments, and a scavenger hunt to find hidden Christmas trees while supplies lasted.
facts: Letters to Santa written at the QC Hometown Christmas tree lighting were delivered in 2025 by members of the Mayor's Teen Advisory Committee, according to the town's notice. The parade theme changes each year: the 2025 parade was Rockin' Around QC, bringing back the nostalgic holiday magic of the 1950s to 1980s, while an earlier year's parade carried the title A Storybook Christmas. The town also decorates downtown with a Lights on Ellsworth holiday display, which the Town of Queen Creek has promoted on its social pages.
trains: Queen Creek has a Christmas train of its own at Schnepf Farms, where the Illumination Express train ride is part of Christmas at Schnepf Farms and train rides are sold as a ticket add-on. Nearby, the Mesa Santa Express carries families on a decorated Valley Metro light rail car, and McCormick-Stillman Railroad Park in Scottsdale runs a Holiday Lights train ride. The Arizona Railway Museum in Chandler is the closest railroad museum to Queen Creek.

traditions: The Town of Queen Creek holds a tree lighting on Friday evening and a parade on Saturday morning at Town Center.
Kids write letters to Santa at the tree lighting, and in 2025 teen advisors delivered them.
The farm adds a train ride, a carousel, ice skating, reindeer hayrides and visits with Santa.
Horseshoe Park hosts a vendor market with Santa, a petting zoo and a Kids Zone.
The town puts up a holiday light display along Ellsworth Road downtown.
kidfact: Kids who write to Santa at the Queen Creek tree lighting have their letters delivered by members of the Mayor's Teen Advisory Committee.
faq: Where is the Queen Creek tree lighting held?

The Town of Queen Creek holds QC Hometown Christmas at Queen Creek Town Center, 21802 S Ellsworth Road. The tree lighting is on a Friday evening, and the page lists letters to Santa, pictures with Santa, music, a Santa's Workshop for decorating garland and ornaments, a scavenger hunt and food trucks.
What is the Queen Creek Christmas parade route?

In 2025 the Rockin' Around QC parade ran along Ellsworth Road, starting at Maya and traveling south to Aldecoa Drive, beginning at 10 am on Saturday. The town prints a new route notice before each parade, so check its Know Before You Go post for road closures and parking.
Is there a Christmas train ride in Queen Creek?

Yes. Christmas at Schnepf Farms includes the Illumination Express train ride, which the farm's ticket page lists as a ride add-on. For a different kind of train, the Mesa Santa Express uses a decorated Valley Metro light rail car in nearby Mesa each December.
Can kids meet Santa in Queen Creek?

Yes. Santa takes pictures at QC Hometown Christmas, and Christmas at Schnepf Farms lists a Santa's Toy Shop, pictures with Santa and cookie decorating with Mrs. Claus. Cowboy Christmas and Trade Days at Horseshoe Park also lists Santa Claus in limited hours at a photo booth.
What can toddlers do at Christmas at Schnepf Farms?

The farm advertises a Christmas carousel, a toddler bouncy house, hayrides to see reindeer, snow globe mini golf and Christmas movies, and says children ages 2 and under are free. Check the ticket calendar for the date you want, since prices and hours vary by night.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Queen Creek for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 through December 27 (Christmas at Schnepf Farms), with the Queen Creek Playdate: Jammies and Jingle Bells (December 2), QC Hometown Christmas tree lighting and parade (December 4 and 5) and Queen Creek Cowboy Christmas and Trade Days (December 19 and 20) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

  • Parades and tree lightings: QC Hometown Christmas tree lighting (December 4) and parade (December 5)
